title: Category Header / Basic
description:
### The basic variant of the page header for product lists aka categories. This contains not only the page title (category title), but also space for a short SEO text and an in-page navigation.

‌

---

<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As** a user browsing a category page on an online store,  
**I want** to see a clear category title, relevant navigation links, and visually engaging styling,  
**so that** I can understand what section I'm in, quickly access related subcategories, and enjoy a consistent, themed shopping experience.

---

## **Acceptance criteria :**

* slider for **laioutr** theme with category nodes **compact**

## **Technical Details:**

sections/CategoryHeaderBasic

```
interface CategoryNodesBasicProps {
  colorMode: 'on-light' | 'on-dark' | 'on-bright';
  
  header: string;
  
  subline?: string;
  
  nodesVariant : 'basic' | 'big' | 'compact';
  
  nodes : categoryNodeBasic[] | categoryNodeBig[] | categoryNodeCompact[]; 
}
```

### Notes:

* use `<component>` tag to determine which slider you will render based on the variant prop 
* subline has maxwidth on large screens 
* use for section background :` background: var(--category-title-basic-bg-color);`
* use  LuiText , `LuiInpageNavigationCompactSlider` , `LuiInpageNavigationBasicSlider`,`LuiInpageNavigationBigSlider`

summary: Page header for product listing pages with category title, SEO text, and in-page navigation slider.
features: Dynamic category title rendered as semantic h1 element
Multiple in-page navigation slider variants (basic, big, compact)
Theme-aware background customization via design tokens
Automatic sibling category display at leaf nodes
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Category Header Basic component serves as the primary orientation element on product listing pages. It communicates the current category context to shoppers while providing quick navigation to subcategories through an integrated slider component. The optional SEO text area supports search engine optimization goals.

## Use Cases

- Display category title with SEO text on product listing pages
- Show in-page category node sliders for quick subcategory access
- Present sibling categories when viewing leaf-level categories with no children
- Support multiple visual themes with distinct slider layouts and styling
- Enable CMS-editable SEO content per locale

## Design Rationale

The component dynamically renders different slider variants based on theme configuration, allowing visual consistency across the store while providing flexibility for different merchandise strategies. The automatic fallback to sibling categories at leaf nodes ensures the navigation remains useful even at the deepest category levels. Background theming via CSS variables enables per-category customization without code changes.
shortDescription: SEO text supports rich formatting (bold, italic, links) and is editable per locale via CMS. Subline has maxwidth on large screens. Slider presets can be changed globally or per specific category; users may opt to show no category nodes for small stores. Current category is highlighted in the nodes slider. WCAG 2.1 AA compliant with keyboard navigability, proper ARIA roles, and lazy-loading support. Uses LuiText and LuiInpageNavigation slider components.
